notes.title: Level and collision update
notes.content:
List of changes for the past week.
• The characteristics of the character's collision area changed, it is now longer and wider.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31870431/f983bccbc159912a1fa7f49c88cf321c3039fb33.png[/img]
• The collision area is not reflected on the X axis when you rotate the hero.
• The walls around the stairs are cleaned and fused with common walls.
• A bug with a gas mask on fixed.
• Box collider on walls replaced by Polygons.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31870431/2154286e40c253342dae0b312d79e6168ca026ba.png[/img]
